notifications.enrollmentDetail: Students with pending enrollment after the deadline.
notifications.blockedDetail: Check whether any should be reactivated or deactivated.

enrollmentCheck.title: Verify enrollments
enrollmentCheck.subtitle: Automatically deactivates the cards of students who didn't complete their enrollment on time.
enrollmentCheck.rule: If the current date is past the deadline, active cards of students with pending enrollment become Deactivated (reason: enrollment not completed, by: System). The others don't change.
enrollmentCheck.notYet: The enrollment deadline hasn't passed yet, so no card was deactivated.
enrollmentCheck.candidatesSubtitle: Active cards of students with pending enrollment. Another {{unchanged}} active student cards won't change.

enrollmentCheck.inTimeTitle: The enrollment period is still open
enrollmentCheck.inTimeMessage: Once the current date is past the deadline, you'll see here the cards that will be deactivated.
enrollmentCheck.confirmMessage: {{count}} cards of students with pending enrollment will be deactivated. This action is recorded in the history.
enrollmentCheck.confirmMessageInTime: The enrollment deadline hasn't passed yet, so no card will be deactivated. Do you want to run the verification anyway?
enrollmentCheck.partialError: {{count}} cards couldn't be deactivated. Run the verification again.

register.title: Register reader
register.subtitle: The reader is created as Registered; activate it once it's installed.

DEACTIVATE.title: Deactivate reader
DEACTIVATE.message: {{id}} · {{name}} will stop processing taps. Anyone tapping their card will see "Reader out of service".

START_MAINTENANCE.title: Start maintenance
START_MAINTENANCE.message: {{id}} · {{name}} will be out of service until you end the maintenance.

END_MAINTENANCE.title: End maintenance
END_MAINTENANCE.message: {{id}} · {{name}} will be active again and will process taps.

errors.COMMUNICATION_INTERVAL_INVALID: The communication interval must be a whole number greater than 0.

healthCheck.reconnected: {{id}} is connected again · signal {{signal}} dBm. The disconnection incident was closed.

alerts.outOfServiceMessage: Anyone tapping their card will see "Reader out of service". Activate it or end the maintenance to use it again.
